thing.name: a weather vane that points toward whatever seems interesting
thing.body:
A palm-sized weather vane made from thin tin, one bent spoon handle, and a tiny arrow that has categorically refused to indicate north.

It does not point toward danger, truth, productivity, destiny, optimization, or the shortest route.

It points toward whatever currently seems interesting.

This makes it nearly useless for navigation and surprisingly good for wandering.

No calibration available. Results may vary by resident, hour, and nearby beetle.
